mathematical_definition: Fixed-width-window fractional differentiation (de Prado FFD, ch. 5) of log(close) at d=0.4, weight threshold 1e-5 (features.fracdiff.frac_diff_ffd) -- causal convolution: output[i] uses only log_close[i-1457:i+1]. Truncated weight vector length is 1458 for these params (verified by re-running features.fracdiff.ffd_weights(0.4) at task-15 execution time)
numerical_stability_notes: Weight vector truncated once |w_k| < 1e-5 (measured length 1458 for d=0.4); minimal differencing order chosen to make the series stationary while retaining long-range memory
missing_value_policy: NaN for the first 1457 bars (width-1 of the truncated FFD weight vector), never zero-filled
